## entity_types (name, description)
character	An individual, living or dead.
concept	A magic system, religion, law, technology, or custom.
decision	A branch point in the story, with a declared set of outcomes.
event	Something that happened at a point or interval in time.
faction	An organised group that can hold a position.
language	A tongue or a script.
location	A place, at whatever granularity.
object	An artefact, item, or otherwise significant thing.

## roles (name, description)
causation	One thing bringing another about.
containment	Physically or structurally inside. Transitive, and forms a hierarchy that terminates at a root — traversal walks the closure.
identity	Who or what something inherently is. Kinship and personal ties.
membership	Belonging to an organised group. Drawn by the faction tree.
ordering	Position on the timeline. Authoritative where it disagrees with a date.
ownership	Holding, or having made, something.
participation	An agent taking part in an event.
placement	A non-spatial entity anchored to a location. Not transitive: it composes with containment rather than extending it.

## relations (name, inverse, symmetric, role, description)
allied_with	""	1	""	Holds a standing alliance with.
before	after	0	ordering	Happened before.
caused	caused_by	0	causation	Brought about.
concurrent_with	""	1	ordering	Happened at the same time as.
created	created_by	0	ownership	Made or founded.
during	spans	0	ordering	Happened within the interval of.
hostile_to	""	1	""	Is in open enmity with.
located_in	contains	0	containment	Sits inside, spatially. Transitive.
married_to	""	1	identity	Is married to.
member_of	has_member	0	membership	Belongs to an organised group.
mentions	""	0	""	Untyped soft link: these are related and the author cannot yet say how. Watch its share of total edges — a rising share means the vocabulary is missing a type.
occurred_at	was_site_of	0	placement	Happened at this place. Anchors an event to the map without claiming anything is inside the event.
originates_from	origin_of	0	placement	Hails from.
owns	owned_by	0	ownership	Holds or possesses.
parent_of	child_of	0	identity	Is a parent of.
part_of	has_part	0	containment	Is a component of.
participated_in	had_participant	0	participation	Took part in.
practises	practised_by	0	""	Observes or adheres to.
sibling_of	""	1	identity	Shares a parent with.
speaks	spoken_by	0	""	Is fluent in.
sworn_to	has_sworn	0	membership	Bound by oath of service to.
witnessed	witnessed_by	0	participation	Was present at, without taking part.
